semiconductor_relevance: High — Laiku (Suzhou) Vacuum Technology specializes in vacuum welding chambers and components specifically for semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: Laiku (Suzhou) Vacuum Technology Co., Ltd. is a leading supplier of high-end vacuum welding chambers and components tailored for the semiconductor industry. With over 27 years of experience, the company provides advanced welding technology solutions and full-chain manufacturing capabilities, including ultra-high vacuum chambers and cleanroom environments.
capabilities: Manufacturing of ultra-vacuum coated stainless steel/aluminum alloy chambers

regional_presence.China: The company is based in Suzhou, China, and serves high-tech industries including semiconductors.
